text: Offer pasupu, kumkuma and gandham to the vigraham.
If you have vigrahas at home, gandham, pasupu, kumkuma and akshatalu are usually offered to them.
But for nitya puja to stay easy, there is no need to do this separately for every deity in the house each day.
You may offer to Ganapati and to Gauri Devi, and carry the puja on.
If you have photographs, there is no need to wipe off the gandham or kumkuma on them and put it on afresh every day.
Leave them as they are and carry the puja on.
Whenever you feel like cleaning the photographs and dressing them anew, you may.
Nitya puja does not mean doing everything from the beginning every day.
What matters is being able to carry it on every day — easily, with devotion.
